x: Stone had increased his lead when they came round again and although Len Herbert was still with Butler and Wheeler of Surrey, with Les Stokell close behind the rest of our chaps had fallen back and we were hoping for a usual last lap Belgrave effort.

In the 200 yards we had Butler, who is a 2nd claim member, and Don Newell running for us, but had to be content with 4th and 6th places. Alan Bishop was 2nd in the 440, and "Ginger" Newell turned out in the 880 and finished second.
Eddie Short ran our final lap of about 3 miles, and although he caught Butler, of Surrey A.C., he was eventually beaten on the final run-in by about a yard.
A new holder was also produced in the Senior 100 yards, the finalists being Mayers, Walden, Butler, Merrett, Key and Holtum., Merrett eventually winning from Mayers with Walden third.
